_comment: DECLARATIVE motor_carrier floorplan, same schema as carrier/floorplan.json. Order in each edge list = order ALONG that edge (N/S left->right, W/E top->bottom). USB inlets and microSD on N as on the carrier; the ESC power path (XT60 in and out) alone on E; the ESC signal header, CAN and expansion headers on S; the RJ45 on W.

pull.basis: magnetics seat at the RJ45 jack, the carrier's rule (Pulse HX5008 guidance: part-to-part at most 25 mm); same pull as carrier/floorplan.json
CP2102N FS pair terminates at the UART USB-C: the near_max seat rule of carrier/floorplan.json and devkit_mini/floorplan.json
